name: Harucon
organizer: AMAI (Association for Manga and Anime in Israel)
blurb: AMAI's Purim-season anime and manga convention for Israeli fans, covering anime, manga, gaming and Japanese pop culture.
notes: Correction to the assignment brief: the 2026 edition was not held at ICC Jerusalem -- the site itself says it is AMAI's 'virtual anime and manga convention', held Tuesday 31.03.2026, 11:00-21:00, entirely on AMAI's Discord server ('celebrate our love of anime safely online'), so venue is recorded as 'Online (Discord)'. City/country (Jerusalem, IL) reflect AMAI's home base rather than a physical venue for this edition. That date already passed before this research window opens (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as 'last' rather than guessed forward; no 2027 date is announced on the site yet, and it is unclear whether the next edition returns in person.
